name: Barbell Single-Arm Snatch
steps: Stand over the center of the bar, bend your knees and hips and take a centered overhand grip with one hand.
Push through your feet, extend sharply at the hips and pull under the bar to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Stand fully and steady both ends of the bar before lowering it.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Grip the exact center of the bar so neither end tips sideways during the lift.
Power the lift with a sharp hip extension rather than pulling early with your arm.
